premise: The huge ship's crew elevator comes down with the biggest parcel ever: the folded-up building printer, which unfolds and prints its very first layer.
inspiration: The Trojan horse of Homer and Virgil, a giant gift with something hidden inside, turned: the hidden thing is a helper, not a trick.
lesson: Some gifts are best when they help you build.

en-US.title: The Biggest Parcel
en-US.text: The huge {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} ship had landed on the pad, and everyone at the base was waiting. {all:face happy} Today it had brought the biggest parcel ever delivered to the Moon. {ship:live hold} {sfx:whirr} Down came its crew elevator, slow and smooth, all the way to the ground. [curious] On it sat a great folded bundle of white and orange metal. {all:face surprised} What could it be? [short pause] Then out of the bundle unfolded the {printer:enter} building printer: a leg, another leg, a long arm, a hopper on top! {all:hop} [excited] Everyone gasped. The {excavator:enter} excavator came trundling up {excavator:go to printer} to say hello the only way it knew. {excavator:live} It dug up a big scoop of moon soil {sfx:pour} and tipped it into the hopper. {printer:live} Back and forth went the printer, laying its very first layer, neat and grey. {excavator:hop} {ship:live resume} The ship drew its elevator back up. {ship:pulse} [playfully] {all:face happy} Parcel delivered. And this parcel could build its own house.

es-ES.title: El paquete más grande
es-ES.text: La enorme {ship:enter} {ship:go to pad} nave había aterrizado en la plataforma, y en la base todos esperaban. {all:face happy} Hoy traía el paquete más grande que había llegado nunca a la Luna. {ship:live hold} {sfx:whirr} Bajó su ascensor, suave y despacio, hasta el suelo. [curious] Encima había un gran fardo plegado de metal blanco y naranja. {all:face surprised} ¿Qué sería? [short pause] Entonces, del fardo se desplegó la {printer:enter} impresora de edificios: una pata, otra pata, un brazo largo, ¡y una tolva encima! {all:hop} [excited] Todos se quedaron boquiabiertos. La {excavator:enter} excavadora llegó traqueteando {excavator:go to printer} para saludar como mejor sabía. {excavator:live} Recogió una buena palada de tierra lunar {sfx:pour} y la echó en la tolva. {printer:live} La impresora fue y vino, dejando su primera capa, gris y ordenada. {excavator:hop} {ship:live resume} La nave volvió a subir su ascensor. {ship:pulse} [playfully] {all:face happy} Paquete entregado. Y este paquete podía construirse su propia casa.

whirr.prompt: a smooth mechanical whir of a big elevator platform lowering, gentle hum

pour.prompt: dry gritty soil pouring into a metal hopper, a soft rushing hiss
